skills.name: Twinblade Wolf
lines: Consumes one Divine Wolf to perform the following moves in succession at no MP cost: Wolf Howl -> Fa Jin Slash (Non type slash attack on a single enemy) -> Crusher Blow (Wind type slash attack on all enemies x5) -> Sky Mirror -> Starving Wolf (Wind type slash attack on a single enemy x2)
* If user has not learned a skill in the sequence, the sequence ends at that skill.
* If user has learned the upgraded versions of Wolf Howl (Howling Heart -> Howling Soul) use the most powerful version instead.
* Replaces the basic attack when user possesses Divine Wolf stack.
* Because the skills performed by using Twinblade Wolf are not basic attack replacements themselves, the Enhance Normal Attack Grasta will not increase their damage.
